title: An excellent and fun time.
text: Our tour guide was wonderful, full of knowledge and a great historian. We all absolutely loved that he was fluent in English.
author: Joyce_P

title: Very good tour company
text: Well done. Good route and very informative. We had to cut the tour short to make our flight. We will be back in a couple months and try another tour with them. Tour guide was excellent and well versed.
author: Greg_M

title: Excellent tour for sure!
text: Great having such a small group experience!  Was able to get near places without having to walk as far.  That is wonderful in such a busy tourist city.
author: Eleanor_B

title: We enjoyed being in a...
text: We enjoyed being in a small group. Daniel was an excellent guide. We were grateful that we were taken to our cruise ship at the end of the tour.
author: Pam_B

title: Wonderful tour, great...
text: Wonderful tour, great small group. We were picked up at the cruise terminal and were shown all the city highlights. Highly recommend!
author: Marcy_S

title: Just enough
text: This tour was just enough of the highlights of Barcelona to give you an idea of what to do next. Nothing in depth mostly drive bys. Our guide Marta was very nice
author: Marie_L

title: Worth the money
text: Loved our tour guide, Elaina. She made us feel very welcomed to Barcelona, her home that she loves and is proud of.
author: Rich_M

title: Quick overview of Barcelona
text: Great overview of Barcelona. Our guide, Moises, was extremely knowledgeable of the history of Barcelona. We went to view Barcelona from a mountaintop, the old town and Sagrada Família. Wonderful experience!
author: Keith_K

title: Great experience
text: Great communication prior to tour. Van was comfortable. Guide was very informative and friendly. Highly recommend
author: LoriL197020

title: Best way to enjoy Barcelona
text: We love this tour! Martha our guide tour was amazing! She was so helpful and professional. If I go back to Barcelona, I will definitely take this tour again! I recommended!
author: MariaE_R
